repos.description: Local-first AI coding agent desktop: Electron + Rust host core + pi Agent Harness + user-installable plugins
repos.summary_zh: PI-Desktop是一款本地优先的AI编程代理桌面应用，采用Electron + Rust架构。支持OpenAI、Anthropic及自定义模型，提供Agent/Plan/Goal三种协作模式，内置权限审查层与可扩展插件系统，实现跨平台独立编码工作空间。
repos.summary_en: PI-Desktop is a local-first AI coding agent desktop app built with Electron and Rust. It supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and custom models, offers Agent/Plan/Goal modes with permission controls and an extensible plugin system for cross-platform independent coding workspaces.

repos.description: A multi-model AI agent desktop client — connect any AI provider, extend with MCP & skills, control from your phone. Built with Electron + Next.js.
repos.summary_zh: CodePilot 是一个基于 Electron + Next.js 构建的 Claude Code 桌面 GUI 客户端，提供多模型提供商支持、MCP 扩展、自定义技能、跨平台通信及项目感知型智能助手工作区，实现可视化聊天、编码与项目管理一体化体验。
repos.summary_en: CodePilot is a desktop GUI client for Claude Code built with Electron and Next.js, offering multi-provider support, MCP extensions, custom skills, cross-platform bridging, and an AI assistant workspace that understands your projects through persistent memory and onboarding flows.

repos.description: 达尔文.skill —— 一个让你的Skill无限进化的系统：评估→改进→测试→保留或回滚 | Autoresearch-inspired autonomous skill optimization for Claude Code. Evaluate, improve, test, keep or revert.
repos.summary_zh: 达尔文.skill 是一个受 autoresearch 启发的自主 Skill 优化系统，通过评估→改进→测试→保留/回滚的闭环循环，持续提升 Claude Code 等 Agent 工具的 Skill 性能。采用双重评估机制（结构质量+实际效果）和棘轮机制，确保每次修改只保留可测量的改进，支持 8 维度加权评分体系与人在回路验证。
repos.summary_en: Darwin.skill is an autonomous skill optimization system inspired by autoresearch, featuring a closed-loop cycle of evaluate-improve-test-keep/revert to continuously enhance agent skills in tools like Claude Code. It employs dual evaluation (structural quality + actual performance) and a ratchet mechanism to ensure only measurable improvements are retained, using an 8-dimensional weighted scoring system with human-in-the-loop validation.

repos.description: 🎃 A fast, out-of-the-box macOS terminal built for AI coding.
repos.summary_zh: Kaku 是一款专为 AI 编程优化的终端模拟器，基于 WezTerm 深度定制。它提供开箱即用的体验，支持零配置启动、主题自适应切换、内置 zsh 插件及轻量级高性能内核，并集成 AI 助手用于命令行错误修复与智能编码辅助。
repos.summary_en: Kaku is a high-performance terminal emulator built for AI coding, forked from WezTerm with deep customizations. It offers zero-config setup, theme-aware UI, integrated shell tools, and a built-in AI assistant for command recovery and coding support.

repos.description: Zero-Config Code Flow for Claude code & Codex
repos.summary_zh: ZCF 是一款零配置 Claude Code & Codex 代码流工具，提供一键安装、双语界面、智能代理系统和个性化 AI 助手。支持多种 API 提供商（如 302.AI、GLM、PackyCode 等），内置工作流、MCP 集成，并持续更新维护，适合开发者快速部署 AI 编程环境。
repos.summary_en: ZCF (Zero-Config Code Flow) is a zero-configuration tool for Claude Code & Codex, enabling one-click setup with bilingual support, intelligent agent system, and personalized AI assistants. It supports multiple API providers (e.g., 302.AI, GLM, PackyCode), includes workflows and MCP integration, and is actively maintained for seamless AI coding experience.

repos.description: 多模型协作工作流引擎 — /ccg:go 一个命令，AI 自动分析意图、选择策略、编排 Codex + Gemini + Claude 协作执行
repos.summary_zh: CCG 是一个多模型协作开发系统，通过 Claude 编排 Codex（后端）与 Gemini（前端），提供 28 个命令覆盖完整开发流程。支持零配置路由、安全补丁审查及 OPSX 规范驱动开发，实现 AI 智能体协同编程。
repos.summary_en: CCG is a multi-model collaboration system where Claude orchestrates Codex (backend) and Gemini (frontend), offering 28 slash commands for full-stack development. Features zero-config routing, secure patch review, and OPSX-driven spec development for AI agent teamwork.

repos.description: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Skills Manager 是一款轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、同步和组织 AI 智能体技能，支持 15+ 主流开发工具（如 Cursor、Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 等）。通过中央仓库集中管理技能，支持从 Git 仓库、本地文件或市场导入，一键同步至目标工具，并提供场景分组、更新追踪和技能文档预览功能。
repos.summary_en: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app that centralizes the management, sync, and organization of AI agent skills across 15+ coding tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot. It supports importing skills from Git repos, local folders, or the marketplace into a unified repository, enables one-click sync via symlinks/copies, and offers scenario grouping, update tracking, and in-app skill documentation preview.

repos.description: 【🔞🔞🔞 内含不适合未成年人阅读的图片】基于我擅长的编程、绘画、写作展开的 AI 探索和总结：StableDiffusion 是一种强大的图像生成模型，能够通过对一张图片进行演化来生成新的图片。ChatGPT 是一个基于 Transformer 的语言生成模型，它能够自动为输入的主题生成合适的文章。而 Github Copilot 是一个智能编程助手，能够加速日常编程活动。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目深入探索了基于编程、绘画与写作的AI应用，涵盖StableDiffusion图像生成、ChatGPT文本创作及GitHub Copilot代码辅助。通过Prompt工程实践，系统解析了AI模型在图像描述、文章构思与代码生成中的交互逻辑，并提出了'Prompt编程'概念，探讨自然语言驱动软件开发的可能性。
repos.summary_en: This project explores AI applications in programming, painting, and writing through StableDiffusion image generation, ChatGPT text creation, and GitHub Copilot code assistance. It systematically analyzes how AI models interact with human input via prompt engineering for image description, article structuring, and code generation, proposing the concept of 'prompt programming' as a bridge between natural language and software development.

repos.description: The go-to web for your AI coding agent — local-first search, fetch, crawl & research over MCP. No API keys, no cloud, $0/query. Public beta.
repos.summary_zh: wigolo 是一款本地优先的 AI 智能体网页情报 MCP 服务器，为 AI 编程助手提供搜索、抓取、爬取及自主研究能力。它完全运行于本地（~/.wigolo/），无需 API 密钥或云服务，实现零成本查询，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流工具，是 AI 时代替代传统付费搜索 API 的隐私保护方案。
repos.summary_en: wigolo is a local-first MCP server delivering web intelligence for AI coding agents. It provides search, fetch, crawl, and autonomous research capabilities entirely on-device without API keys or cloud services. Supporting Claude Code, Cursor, and other major tools, it offers a privacy-focused, zero-cost alternative to metered search APIs.

repos.summary_zh: HumanLayer 提供的 Claude Code 技能集合，涵盖指令优化、React 类型收窄、Agentic 迭代循环构建与 GitHub Actions 自动化等工作流辅助能力，显著提升开发者编程效率与代码质量。
repos.summary_en: A collection of Claude Code skills from HumanLayer, featuring instruction optimization, React prop narrowing, agentic loop automation, and GitHub Actions integration to boost developer productivity and code quality.

repos.description: Warcraft III Peon voice notifications (+ more!) for Claude Code, Codex, IDEs, and any AI agent. Stop babysitting your terminal. Employ a Peon today.
repos.summary_zh: peon-ping 是一款为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf 等）提供 Warcraft III 等游戏角色语音通知的开源工具，支持多平台（macOS/Linux/Windows/WSL2）。通过语音和屏幕横幅提醒开发者任务完成或需要交互，避免终端监控中断工作流，同时支持自定义音效包和 MCP 集成。
repos.summary_en: peon-ping is an open-source tool that delivers Warcraft III and other game character voice notifications to AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It alerts users via audio and on-screen banners when tasks complete or require attention, eliminating constant terminal monitoring. Supports cross-platform use, custom sound packs, and MCP integration.

repos.description: AI coding platform for teams
repos.summary_zh: MonkeyCode 是一款企业级 AI 编程助手，专为研发协作与管理场景设计，支持私有化部署与本地大模型接入，提供 IDE 对话式编程、代码补全、安全扫描及 Git 平台机器人能力，内置企业级管理面板用于审计管控与资源统一调度，兼顾效率与代码安全。
repos.summary_en: MonkeyCode is an enterprise-grade AI programming assistant designed for R&D collaboration and management. It supports private deployment, local LLM integration, and offline usage, offering IDE-based coding, intelligent completions, security scanning, Git platform bots, and a management panel for auditing, compliance, and centralized model usage control.

repos.description: cursor IDE enjoy VIP
repos.summary_zh: cursor-vip 是一个通过共享方式解锁 Cursor IDE 付费 VIP 功能的工具，支持多语言配置与代理模式。它提供稳定的 Claude 模型访问，通过脚本或二进制文件快速部署，适用于开发者绕过区域限制使用高级 AI 编程功能，但稳定性不及官方版本。
repos.summary_en: cursor-vip is a tool that unlocks Cursor IDE's paid VIP features via shared access, supporting multi-language configuration and proxy modes. It offers stable Claude model access, easy deployment via scripts or binaries, and enables developers to use advanced AI coding features despite regional payment restrictions, though with lower stability than the official version.

repos.description: Your agents don’t hand off the work. Kungfu keeps the same Work moving across Codex, Claude, OpenCode, and your own execution surface.
repos.summary_zh: Kungfu 是一款面向 AI 智能体的连续性保障框架，旨在解决会话结束后工作丢失的痛点。它通过声明式项目源管理上下文，使智能体在重启或切换时无需重复解释即可无缝续接任务，并保留完整的决策证据与行动边界。
repos.summary_en: Kungfu is a continuity framework for AI agents, designed to prevent work loss when chats end. It manages context from declared project sources, allowing agents to seamlessly resume tasks across restarts or handoffs without re-explaining, preserving decision evidence and action boundaries.

repos.description: Run Claude Design locally as an Agent Skill — Cursor, Claude Code & more. Produce polished UI mockups, prototypes, decks & wireframes as self-contained HTML, without claude.ai/design. Best with Opus or Claude.
repos.summary_zh: baoyu-design 将 Claude Design 设计引擎封装为本地 Agent Skill，可在 Cursor、Claude Code 等编码 Agent 中直接生成高质量 UI 原型、线框图、落地页、仪表盘和演示文稿，输出为自包含 HTML。无需访问 claude.ai/design 网站，支持 Opus 4.8 获得最佳效果，通过 localhost 预览实现可视化迭代编辑。
repos.summary_en: baoyu-design packages the Claude Design engine as a portable Agent Skill, enabling local coding agents like Cursor and Claude Code to generate polished UI mockups, prototypes, wireframes, landing pages, dashboards, and slide decks as self-contained HTML. No website or subscription needed—everything runs locally with tight visual iteration via localhost preview, best paired with Opus 4.8.

repos.description: 把 Markdown 一键排成可直接粘进公众号编辑器的精致 HTML —— 6 套精选主题 + 主题生成器 + 双关卡校验。An AI-agent skill that turns Markdown into paste-ready WeChat article HTML.
repos.summary_zh: gzh-design-skill 是一款专为 AI Agent 设计的公众号排版工具，能将 Markdown 一键转换为可直接粘贴进微信公众号编辑器的精致 HTML。它提供 6 套精选主题及自定义主题生成器，通过全内联样式与特定标签规避平台过滤，并具备章节编号、关键词标记及双关卡质量校验功能，确保排版的高保真与一致性。
repos.summary_en: gzh-design-skill is an AI-agent skill that converts Markdown into paste-ready WeChat Official Account HTML. It features 6 preset themes and a custom theme generator, utilizing inline styles and specific tags to bypass platform filters. With auto-numbering, keyword marking, and dual-stage quality validation, it ensures high-fidelity, consistent formatting for content creators.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg是一款协作式多智能体AI编码工作空间，统一整合Claude Code、Codex、Grok等15+主流AI编程代理。提供桌面应用、自托管服务及Docker部署方案，支持跨平台使用。核心特性包括会话跨代理迁移、任务委托协作、统一对话界面，大幅降低多代理协作门槛。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace unifying 15+ AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Grok. Supports desktop, self-hosted, and Docker deployments across all platforms. Key features include session migration between agents, collaborative task delegation via @mentions, and a unified conversation interface.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg 是一个企业级多智能体编码工作台，统一集成 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等本地 AI 编程助手。支持桌面应用、独立服务器或 Docker 部署，提供浏览器远程访问。核心功能包括对话聚合、Git worktree 并行开发、MCP/Skills 管理、Telegram/Lark 等聊天渠道集成及终端集成，实现全链路工程化开发流程。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace that unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container. It enables remote development via any browser with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree workflows, MCP/Skills management, chat channel integration (Telegram, Lark, iLink), and integrated terminal/file/Git workflows.

repos.description: A plugin for AI coding agents (Antigravity, Claude Code) enabling Spec-Driven Development to specify, plan, and implement software features.
repos.summary_zh: Conductor 是 Gemini CLI 的扩展工具，通过上下文驱动开发（Context-Driven Development）实现软件功能的规范化生命周期管理。它支持在编码前制定详细规格与执行计划，确保代码质量与团队一致性，适用于新项目和现有项目的智能开发流程管控。
repos.summary_en: Conductor is a Gemini CLI extension enabling Context-Driven Development by managing the full lifecycle of software features—from context setup, spec/plan generation, to safe implementation. It ensures high-quality, team-aligned development with intelligent planning and git-aware reverts.

repos.description: 面向 AI Agent 的微信公众号创作与发布 CLI：Markdown 排版、AI 配图、预览与草稿创建；支持由浏览器 Agent 保存知乎、CSDN、头条未发布草稿。
repos.summary_zh: md2wechat 是一款专为 AI 时代设计的公众号创作工具，支持用 Markdown 编写文章并一键转换为精美排版，自动上传至微信草稿箱。提供 43 个高级排版模块、40+ 专业主题、AI 配图及批量发布功能，全流程 CLI 操作，兼容 Claude Code 等智能体，让公众号写作高效如发朋友圈。
repos.summary_en: md2wechat is an AI-native WeChat article creation tool that converts Markdown into beautifully formatted posts and auto-uploads to the draft box. It offers 43 advanced layout modules, 40+ professional themes, AI image generation, and batch publishing via CLI, with native support for agents like Claude Code.

repos.description: Visual Skills Pack for Obsidian: generate Canvas, Excalidraw, and Mermaid diagrams from text with Claude Code
repos.summary_zh: Obsidian Visual Skills Pack 是一个实验性插件，通过 Claude Code 将文本自动转换为 Excalidraw（手绘风格）、Mermaid（流程图）和 Canvas（彩色卡片布局）三种可视化图表。支持中文文本处理、动画生成及多输出模式，适用于思维导图、流程设计、系统架构等场景，显著提升知识表达效率。
repos.summary_en: The Obsidian Visual Skills Pack is an experimental plugin that uses Claude Code to automatically convert text into three types of visual diagrams: Excalidraw (hand-drawn style), Mermaid (flowcharts), and Canvas (colorful card layout). It supports Chinese text, animations, multiple output modes, and is ideal for mind maps, workflows, and system architecture visualization.

repos.description: Remote Control for Codex.
repos.summary_zh: Remodex 是一款本地优先的开源桥接工具，结合 iOS 应用与 macOS 后台服务，实现 iPhone 对 OpenAI Codex 的远程控制。支持端到端加密配对、实时流式交互、Git 操作、子智能体调用及结构化规划模式，提供低延迟响应与细粒度访问控制，全程无需依赖公共服务器。
repos.summary_en: Remodex is a local-first open-source bridge with an iOS app that enables remote control of OpenAI Codex from your iPhone. It features end-to-end encrypted pairing, real-time streaming, Git actions, subagents, planning mode, and secure access controls—all running on-device without relying on public endpoints.

repos.description: Auto-register & manage accounts for ChatGPT, Cursor, Kiro, Grok, Windsurf, Trae & 13+ AI platforms · Protocol/browser dual-mode · Plugin-based · One-click Mac/Windows desktop app
repos.summary_zh: Any Auto Register 是一个多平台账号自动注册与管理系统，支持 Trae.ai、Tavily、Cursor 等主流 AI 平台。采用 FastAPI + React 架构，具备插件化扩展能力，集成邮箱服务（MoeMail/Laoudo/DuckMail）、验证码识别（YesCaptcha/2Captcha/Camoufox）及代理池管理功能，提供实时日志推送的 Web UI 界面。
repos.summary_en: Any Auto Register is a multi-platform account auto-registration and management system supporting major AI platforms like Trae.ai, Tavily, and Cursor. Built with FastAPI + React, it features plugin-based extensibility, integrated mailbox services (MoeMail/Laoudo/DuckMail), captcha solving (YesCaptcha/2Captcha/Camoufox), proxy pool management, and real-time log streaming via SSE to a web UI.

repos.description: The simplest desktop client for OpenClaw 🦞 — bridge your Agent to WeChat, Feishu, Slack & Discord in one click. Works with Claude Code, Codex & any LLM. BYOK, Oauth, local-first, chat from your phone 24/7.
repos.summary_zh: nexu 是一款开源桌面客户端，专为 OpenClaw 🦞 设计，一键桥接 Agent 到微信、飞书、Slack 和 Discord。支持 Claude Code、Codex 等 LLM，采用 BYOK（自带密钥）、OAuth 认证及本地优先架构，实现全天候手机聊天。所有数据本地存储，隐私可控，提供图形化安装与多模型切换功能。
repos.summary_en: nexu is an open-source desktop client for OpenClaw 🦞 that bridges your AI agent to WeChat, Feishu, Slack, and Discord with one click. It works with Claude Code, Codex, and any LLM via BYOK, OAuth, and local-first architecture. Chat from your phone 24/7 with full privacy control—no vendor data routing. Features GUI setup, multi-model support (e.g., Gemini), and built-in IM integrations.

repos.description: Collaborator is a place to create with agents.
repos.summary_zh: Collaborator 是一款面向智能体开发的跨平台桌面应用，将终端、代码编辑器和上下文文件整合在无限画布中，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。基于 Electron 40、React 19 和 Tailwind CSS 4 构建，集成 Monaco 编辑器、xterm.js 终端和 D3 可视化，实现本地优先、无账号的协作开发环境，消除上下文切换，提升智能体协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Collaborator is a cross-platform desktop environment for agentic development, unifying terminals, code editors, and context files on an infinite canvas. Built with Electron 40, React 19, and Tailwind CSS 4, it integrates Monaco Editor, xterm.js terminal, and D3 visualization. Designed for local-first, account-free workflows, it eliminates context switching and enhances agent collaboration across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

repos.description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
repos.summary_zh: Cindy 是一款开源、开箱即用的跨平台 AI Agent 客户端，支持 Claude Code 和 Codex 等多种模型编排。它可在本地运行，集成文件系统访问、浏览器自动化和 MCP 协议，实现跨设备的任务编排与自动化执行。
repos.summary_en: Cindy is an open-source, out-of-the-box AI agent client supporting Claude Code and Codex orchestration. It runs locally with file system access, browser automation, and MCP protocol integration for cross-device task orchestration and automated execution.

repos.description: Bridge Claude Code / Codex to IM platforms — chat with AI coding agents from Telegram, Discord, or Feishu/Lark.
repos.summary_zh: Claude-to-IM Skill 是一个轻量级 CLI 工具，将 Claude Code / Codex 与 Telegram、Discord、飞书/Lark 或 QQ 等即时通讯平台桥接，实现通过 IM 聊天与 AI 编程代理交互。支持权限控制、流式响应预览、会话持久化，无需编码即可快速部署。
repos.summary_en: Claude-to-IM Skill is a lightweight CLI tool that bridges Claude Code/Codex with IM platforms like Telegram, Discord, Feishu/Lark, and QQ. It enables chatting with AI coding agents directly from your chats, featuring permission control, streaming previews, session persistence, and zero-code setup.

repos.description: A Claude Code skill for generating UI in the Nothing design language. Monochrome, typographic, industrial.
repos.summary_zh: 专为 Claude Code 设计的 Nothing 设计语言技能，提供极简工业风 UI 生成能力。基于瑞士排版、OLED 黑、分段进度条等核心视觉规则，支持 HTML/CSS、SwiftUI、React/Tailwind 多平台输出，内置明暗双模式设计令牌系统。
repos.summary_en: A Claude Code skill for generating UI in the Nothing design language. Features monochrome, typographic, industrial aesthetics with Swiss typography, OLED blacks, segmented progress bars, and dot-matrix motifs. Outputs to HTML/CSS, SwiftUI, or React/Tailwind across light/dark mode token systems.

repos.summary_zh: Cursor Fake Machine 是一款专为 Cursor 编辑器设计的 VSIX 扩展工具，通过修改 machineid 实现机器信息伪装，帮助用户绕过设备限制或环境检测，适用于开发环境隔离与多实例管理场景。
repos.summary_en: Cursor Fake Machine is a VSIX extension for the Cursor editor that modifies the machineid to spoof device information, allowing users to bypass device restrictions or environment checks. It's useful for managing isolated development environments or multiple instances.

repos.description: Minimal plugin that lets Claude Code call you on the phone.
repos.summary_zh: CallMe 是一个极简的 Claude Code 插件，允许通过电话在任务完成、卡住或需要决策时呼叫用户。支持多轮语音对话，兼容智能手机、智能手表等设备，并可通过 ngrok 实现远程 webhook 连接。
repos.summary_en: CallMe is a minimal plugin for Claude Code that enables phone calls to alert users when tasks are done, stuck, or require decisions. It supports multi-turn voice conversations via OpenAI's TTS/STT, works across smartphones and smartwatches, and uses ngrok for secure webhook tunneling.

repos.description: Provider-neutral Codex Skill for producing verified AI presenter videos from a script and an authorized presenter image.
repos.summary_zh: Provider-neutral的Codex Skill，将脚本与授权肖像转化为AI演示者视频。支持9种视觉风格、运行时动态选择AI提供商、音频锁定时间线确保口型同步，内置成本防护与验证交付流程，适配Claude Code、Cursor等多Agent平台。
repos.summary_en: Provider-neutral Agent Skill for producing verified AI presenter videos from scripts. Supports 9 visual styles, dynamic provider selection at runtime, audio-locked timeline for lip-sync accuracy, cost guardrails, and evidence-gated QA. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agent platforms.

repos.description: Collaborator is a place to create with agents.
repos.summary_zh: Collaborator 是一个专为 AI 智能体协作设计的 macOS 桌面应用，提供无限画布环境，集成终端、代码编辑器和文件管理功能。支持多工作区、实时终端交互和拖拽式文件操作，采用 Electron + React 技术栈，所有数据本地存储，适用于端到端的智能体开发流程。
repos.summary_en: Collaborator is a macOS-native desktop app for building with AI agents, featuring an infinite canvas workspace with integrated terminals, code editors, and file navigation. It supports multi-workspace management, real-time agent interaction, and local data storage, built on Electron, React, and xterm.js for seamless agentic development.

repos.description: worktree coding agents command center.
repos.summary_zh: Supacode 是一个原生终端编码智能体指挥中心，专为 macOS 设计。它采用 Swift Composable Architecture 构建，集成 libghostty 实现高性能终端交互，支持通过 mise 管理依赖，提供完整的开发、测试与格式化工具链，致力于提升终端环境下的 AI 辅助编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Supacode is a native terminal coding agent command center for macOS, built with Swift Composable Architecture and integrated with libghostty for high-performance terminal interaction. It supports dependency management via mise and offers a full development workflow including build, test, and formatting tools, focusing on enhancing AI-assisted programming in the terminal environment.

repos.description: ClawGod is a runtime patch applied to the official Claude Code. It continues to be supported with each version update.
repos.summary_zh: ClawGod 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的运行时补丁工具，通过动态注入方式解锁官方版本限制的功能，包括隐藏命令、多智能体协作、屏幕控制等。支持跨平台自动更新与卸载，绿色图标标识已打补丁状态，显著提升开发效率与功能自由度。
repos.summary_en: ClawGod is a runtime patch for Claude Code that unlocks restricted features like hidden commands, multi-agent collaboration, and computer use without Pro subscription. It auto-reapplies patches after updates, uses green branding to indicate patched status, and supports cross-platform installation with one-line scripts.

repos.description: Your AI agent skills, finally organized. A macOS app to browse, edit, and manage skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and Amp.
repos.summary_zh: Chops 是一款 macOS 原生应用，专为统一管理和编辑 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Windsurf、Amp 等 AI 编程工具的代码技能而设计。支持实时文件监控、全文搜索、集合分类和远程技能库连接，提供 SwiftUI + SwiftData 架构下的流畅编辑体验。
repos.summary_en: Chops is a native macOS app that centralizes management of AI coding agent skills across tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It features real-time file watching, full-text search, collections, and remote skill server integration, built with SwiftUI and SwiftData for seamless editing.

repos.description: 中文手绘技术 PPT 整页图像生成 Skill | 21:9 封面 + 16:9 正文配图 | PNG 输出
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个 Codex Skill，用于将文章、课程笔记等内容转化为风格统一的中文手绘技术解释图。支持生成 21:9 封面与 16:9 正文 PNG 图像，强调内容叙事规划与视觉一致性，适用于技术文章配图、课件制作和知识卡片生成，推荐使用 ChatGPT Image 2.0 模型以保证输出质量。
repos.summary_en: This Codex Skill transforms articles, course notes, or outlines into stylistically consistent Chinese hand-drawn technical illustration images. It generates 21:9 cover images and 16:9 content pages in PNG format, emphasizing narrative planning and visual coherence. Ideal for technical articles, courseware, and knowledge cards, it recommends ChatGPT Image 2.0 for optimal output quality.

repos.description: All your AI agent sessions in one place — browse, search, resume. Rust + GPUI.
repos.summary_zh: Wake是一款基于Rust+GPUI的macOS原生应用，聚合Claude、Codex、Copilot、Cursor等多个AI编程代理的会话记录。支持全文搜索（FTS5）、会话一键恢复、本地隐私保护（零网络请求），统一浏览所有编码助手历史。
repos.summary_en: Wake is a native macOS app built with Rust + GPUI that unifies all coding-agent sessions — Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, and more. Features full-text search (FTS5), one-click resume, local-first privacy (zero network), and incremental real-time scanning.

repos.description: 支持 AnyRouter、AgentRouter 的多平台多账号签到，理论兼容所有基于 NewAPI、OneAPI 的平台。
repos.summary_zh: AnyRouter 多账号自动签到工具，支持 AnyRouter 和 AgentRouter 平台，兼容 NewAPI/OneAPI 架构。通过 GitHub Actions 实现定时自动签到，支持多账号并行处理、WAF 绕过及机器人通知，配置灵活且维护良好。
repos.summary_en: A multi-account auto check-in tool for AnyRouter and AgentRouter platforms, compatible with NewAPI/OneAPI architectures. Uses GitHub Actions for scheduled automation, supports parallel account processing, WAF bypass, and notification alerts with flexible configuration.

repos.description: Claude Code 中文开发套件 - 为中国开发者定制的零门槛 AI 编程环境。一键安装完整中文化体验，集成 MCP 服务器、智能上下文管理、安全扫描，支持免翻墙访问。让 AI 编程更简单。
repos.summary_zh: Claude Code 中文开发套件是为中国开发者量身定制的零门槛 AI 编程环境，提供一键安装的全中文化体验。集成 MCP 服务器、智能上下文管理、安全扫描等核心功能，支持免翻墙访问。最新版本融合 Anthropic 黑客松冠军配置，包含 9 个专用智能体、7+ 技能模块、10 个快捷指令和完整规则体系，实现从需求分析到代码审查的全流程 AI 驱动开发。
repos.summary_en: Claude Code Chinese Development Kit is a zero-threshold AI programming environment tailored for Chinese developers, offering one-click installation with full Chinese localization. It integrates MCP servers, intelligent context management, security scanning, and supports direct access without VPN. The latest version incorporates the Anthropic Hackathon-winning configuration, featuring 9 specialized agents, 7+ skill modules, 10 slash commands, and a complete rule system for end-to-end AI-driven development workflows.

repos.description: Skill and MCP server for searching and retrieving icons
repos.summary_zh: Better Icons 是一个图标搜索与检索工具，提供20万+图标资源，支持150+主流图标库（如 Lucide、Heroicons）。可作为 MCP 服务器集成到 AI 编程助手（Cursor/Claude等），或作为 CLI 工具直接调用。具备智能学习、批量获取、跨框架导出等功能，显著提升开发者在 AI 辅助编码中的图标使用效率。
repos.summary_en: Better Icons is a skill and MCP server for searching and retrieving over 200,000 icons from 150+ collections (e.g., Lucide, Heroicons). It integrates with AI coding agents like Cursor and Claude Code via MCP, or functions as a CLI tool. Features include auto-learning usage patterns, batch retrieval, multi-framework exports (React/Vue/Svelte), and direct SVG output to save tokens in AI chats.

repos.description: A dev environment for AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: Jean 是一款基于 Tauri v2 的桌面 AI 助手应用，专为多项目管理、git worktree 自动化及 Claude/Codex/OpenCode CLI 集成设计。支持会话管理、AI 编程助手（含思维链与 MCP 支持）、GitHub 问题追踪、终端集成及远程 Web 访问，提供本地化的无厂商锁定开发体验。
repos.summary_en: Jean is a desktop AI assistant built with Tauri v2, designed for managing multiple projects, git worktrees, and integrating Claude CLI, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. It offers session management, AI-powered development workflows (with thinking modes and MCP support), GitHub integration, terminal access, and remote web access—all running locally without vendor lock-in.

repos.description: Standalone CliProxyAPI usage tracker with SQLite persistence and built-in dashboard.
repos.summary_zh: CPA Usage Keeper 是一款独立的 CLIProxyAPI 用量持久化与仪表盘服务，通过消费 Redis 队列将 CPA 用量数据写入 SQLite，并提供聚合 API 与内置 Web 仪表盘，支持按时间、模型、API Key 等多维度筛选，可视化展示请求量、Token 消耗、成本、缓存命中率及请求健康度。
repos.summary_en: CPA Usage Keeper is a standalone usage persistence and dashboard service for CLIProxyAPI. It consumes Redis usage events into SQLite, exposes aggregation APIs, and provides a built-in web dashboard for request volume, token usage, cost, cache hit rate, success rate, and multi-dimensional filtering by time, model, API key, and provider.

repos.description: 归藏的材质插画 skill：生成带字解释图、图表美化和参考辅助配图。
repos.summary_zh: 歸藏的材质插画 Skill 是专为 AI Agent（如 Claude Code/Codex）设计的配图工具，核心解决文章、PPT 及社交卡片中“中心配图”的生成难题。它通过材质化 3D 风格，将抽象概念、数据图表及工作流程转化为带中文标签的解释图、美化图表及参考辅助图，强调信息传达的准确性与视觉的专业性，适配从小红书卡片到教学材料的多种场景。
repos.summary_en: Guizang Material Illustration Skill is an AI Agent-native tool for generating explanatory center graphics. It transforms abstract concepts, data charts, and workflows into labeled 3D material-style illustrations, beautified charts, and reference-assisted visuals. Focusing on information accuracy and Swiss editorial aesthetics, it supports various scenarios from social media cards to educational content.

repos.description: Free gemini-3-flash  | cursor不倒我不倒🙏 ❌ 这次倒下啦
repos.summary_zh: Cursor2API 是一个将 Cursor Web 转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API 的高性能服务，支持 Claude Sonnet 4.6 模型，提供完全兼容 OpenAI API 格式的接口，具备低延迟响应、安全认证、流式/非流式输出及完善的错误处理机制，可通过 Docker、系统服务或本地编译部署。
repos.summary_en: Cursor2API is a high-performance service that converts Cursor Web into an OpenAI-compatible API, supporting Claude Sonnet 4.6. It offers full OpenAI API compatibility with low-latency responses, secure authentication, streaming/non-streaming support, and robust error handling, deployable via Docker, systemd, or local compilation.

repos.description: Free gemini-3-flash  | cursor不倒我不倒🙏 ❌ 这次倒下啦
repos.summary_zh: Cursor2API 是一个将 Cursor Web 转换为 OpenAI chat/completions API 兼容服务的 Go 项目，支持 Google Gemini-3-flash 模型及自动派生的 thinking 版本，具备高性能、安全认证、工具调用和流式响应等特性，提供 Docker 和系统服务部署方案。
repos.summary_en: Cursor2API is a Go service that converts Cursor Web into an OpenAI chat/completions API-compatible endpoint, supporting Google Gemini-3-flash and its thinking variant. It offers high performance, secure authentication, tool calls, streaming responses, and supports deployment via Docker or systemd services.

repos.description: Spec-driven development workflow for AI coding agents: architecture-first planning, task decomposition, GitHub Issue/PR tracking, Deep Discuss, and adaptive control for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other Markdown-capable agents.
repos.summary_zh: Spec-Driven Develop 是一个平台无关的 AI 代理技能，通过单个 `SKILL.md` 文件为大规模复杂任务提供全流程预开发自动化。它不依赖框架或运行时，而是以纯 Markdown 结构化指令驱动代理完成项目分析、任务拆解、进度跟踪和迭代开发，实现轻量级但高度可控的开发方法论。
repos.summary_en: Spec-Driven Develop is a platform-agnostic AI agent skill that automates pre-development workflows via a single SKILL.md file. It enables any coding agent to execute structured methodologies—including project analysis, task decomposition, and progress tracking—without frameworks or runtime dependencies, offering lightweight yet powerful automation for complex tasks.

repos.description: Give AI coding agents eyes. Records browser sessions, captures screenshots, collects errors, and bundles proof artifacts — so humans can verify what the agent built.
repos.summary_zh: ProofShot 是一个开源 CLI 工具，专为 AI 编程代理设计，提供视觉验证能力。它通过录制浏览器操作视频、捕获关键截图和系统日志，帮助 AI 代理在无头环境中验证 UI 功能是否正确实现。支持与 Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等主流 AI 开发工具集成，自动生成可交互的验证报告，并将结果上传至 GitHub PR，实现端到端的自动化测试闭环。
repos.summary_en: ProofShot is an open-source, agent-agnostic CLI tool that gives AI coding agents visual verification capabilities. It records browser session videos, captures screenshots, and collects console/server logs to validate UI functionality in headless environments. Integrated with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, it auto-generates interactive reports and uploads results to GitHub PRs for seamless human review.

repos.description: QuietHarness：Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 共用的轻量 AI 工作系统
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个经过实战检验的 Claude Code 工作流模板，提供内存管理、上下文工程和任务路由三大核心能力。基于3个月多项目日常使用经验构建，采用三层架构设计：常驻规则层、按需文档层和热数据工作区，实现智能持久化开发伙伴。支持多模型分级路由、自动保存进度、强制验证完成状态，显著提升开发效率与代码质量。
repos.summary_en: A battle-tested Claude Code workflow template featuring memory management, context engineering, and task routing from 3 months of daily usage. Implements a three-layer architecture: always-loaded rules, on-demand docs, and hot working memory. Enables persistent, self-improving development with multi-model routing, auto-save, verification gates, and cross-session task tracking for production-ready workflows.

repos.description: Claude Code 公众号一键排版+发布技能 | Markdown → 微信兼容 HTML → 推送草稿箱 | 30 套主题 + 可视化画廊
repos.summary_zh: 专为 Claude Code 设计的微信公众号一键排版工具，支持 Markdown 转微信兼容 HTML、30 套主题可视化预览、AI 内容增强（对话/图片容器）及直接推送草稿箱，覆盖新闻、科技、设计等多场景风格。
repos.summary_en: A Claude Code skill for seamless WeChat Official Account publishing: converts Markdown to WeChat-compatible HTML, offers 30 visual themes with AI-enhanced content (dialogue/gallery containers), and enables one-click draft publishing via WeChat API.

repos.description: A minimal modern terminal for AI coding experience — Sidebar workspaces; horizontal / vertical split panes; one-click agent launch; per-agent activity readout; live workspace state with one-click Node and branch switching.
repos.summary_zh: kooky 是一款专为 AI 编码打造的现代化 macOS 终端模拟器，基于 libghostty 实现 GPU 渲染。核心特性包括侧边栏工作区、多窗格分屏、一键启动 Claude Code/Gemini CLI 等多种 AI Agent、Git Worktree 隔离开发、右键选中内容直接询问 Agent、模糊快速打开面板以及多行提示词编辑器。支持会话自动恢复、跨窗口拖拽标签页，无账号无遥测，状态完全本地存储。
repos.summary_en: kooky is a minimal modern terminal emulator built for AI coding on macOS, powered by libghostty with GPU rendering. Key features include sidebar workspaces, horizontal/vertical split panes, one-click launch of Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, and other AI agents, Git Worktree isolation, right-click-to-ask-agent on selections, fuzzy Quick Open panel, and a multi-line prompt composer. Sessions auto-resume across restarts, tabs are draggable across panes and windows, and all state stays local with no accounts or telemetry.

repos.description: Agent skill that draws architecture, flowchart, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams as hand-placed SVG, to one linted house style.
repos.summary_zh: SVG 手绘风格架构图绘制技能，为 AI 编码代理提供统一的布局算术、颜色系统与零依赖校验器，支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 40+ 代理，确保生成的序列图、数据流图、生命周期图经 svg-lint 12 项检查后保持 house 样式一致。
repos.summary_en: An agent skill that draws hand-crafted SVG diagrams — architecture, flowchart, sequence, data-flow, lifecycle — following a unified house style with layout arithmetic, a color system, and a zero-dependency linter (svg-lint) with 12 checks. Works with 40+ AI coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot.

repos.description: Create stunning screen recordings for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use. An alternative to Screen Studio.
repos.summary_zh: CursorLens 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为创作者、开发者和团队设计。基于 OpenScreen 构建，深度优化 macOS 原生捕获流程，支持全屏/窗口录制、摄像头画中画、语音录制、时间轴剪辑、字幕生成及多比例导出，无水印且商用免费。
repos.summary_en: CursorLens is a free, open-source screen recorder and editor built on OpenScreen, enhanced for native macOS capture and editing. It supports full-screen/app recording, camera overlay, voice input, timeline editing, subtitle generation, and multi-aspect export—all watermark-free and commercially usable.

repos.description: A review extension for Pi
repos.summary_zh: pi-review 是 Pi AI 编码助手的代码审查扩展，支持通过简洁指令审查未提交变更、分支、提交、PR 及指定文件快照，输出优先级分明的审查结论与可操作建议，并支持自定义审查规范。
repos.summary_en: pi-review is a code review extension for Pi AI coding assistant. It supports reviewing uncommitted changes, branches, commits, PRs, and file snapshots via simple commands, producing prioritized findings with actionable suggestions and custom review guidelines.

repos.description: 源代码
repos.summary_zh: Auto Cursor 是一款专业的 Cursor IDE 管理工具，支持一键备份与恢复账户配置、无感换号及自动轮换到期账户，实现真正的无缝切换。核心功能包括机器ID管理、配置备份、SQLite 数据库更新等，适用于 macOS 和 Windows 平台，所有操作均创建备份以确保安全。
repos.summary_en: Auto Cursor is a professional Cursor IDE management tool enabling one-click backup/restore of account configurations, seamless account switching, and automatic rotation of expired accounts. It manages machine IDs, updates storage.json and SQLite databases, and supports macOS and Windows. All operations create backups for safety and user control.

repos.description: A fast, native RSS reader — plus an agent-facing CLI so your AI agent can read, search and triage your feeds from the shell.
repos.summary_zh: Papr 是一款专为桌面端设计的快速原生 RSS 阅读器，支持订阅管理、智能分类、全文抓取、AI 摘要与问答、音频播放及 FreshRSS 同步，数据本地存储于 SQLite，无云端依赖，提供多语言界面。
repos.summary_en: Papr is a fast, native desktop RSS reader featuring feed organization, smart views, full-text fetching, AI-powered summaries and Q&A, audio playback, FreshRSS sync, and local-first data storage via SQLite—no cloud or account required.

repos.description: Independent iOS client for Lody — native chat, sessions, and coding-agent collaboration on iPhone
repos.summary_zh: 独立开源 iOS 客户端，为 Lody AI 协作平台打造。采用 React Native + Swift 6.0 混合架构，结合 CRDT 数据同步，支持无限聊天、流式文本渲染、代码 Diff 高亮与文件树导航，严格遵循 Apple HIG，提供安全的本地会话与远程服务桥接体验。
repos.summary_en: Independent open-source iOS client for Lody AI platform. Hybrid React Native + Swift 6.0 architecture with CRDT sync (Loro/Flock). Features infinite chat, streaming rendering, code diff highlighting, and file tree. Strictly follows Apple HIG for authentic native experience bridging local sessions and remote services.

repos.description: 🏯 Claude Code / Codex skill — transform Chinese architecture, cultural places & travel photos into art-directed editorial posters with GPT Image. 中国古建筑与在地文化照片 → 艺术指导海报
repos.summary_zh: Yingzao 是将中国古建筑、文化场所与旅行照片转为艺术指导编辑海报的 Agent Skill。它通过构图识别、中式排版设计与图像重绘，保护建筑身份锚点，实现文字与主体的深度互动，支持多图融合与视频分镜扩展。
repos.summary_en: Yingzao is an agent skill that transforms Chinese architectural and cultural photos into art-directed editorial posters. It combines composition analysis, Chinese typography design, and image model generation to preserve architectural identity while creating meaningful text-image interactions, with support for multi-image fusion and video storyboard extension.

repos.description: Pi — A cross-platform AI coding agent, bringing the Claude Code experience to your desktop. No environment setup, no terminal commands. Download and start coding right away.
repos.summary_zh: Pi Agent 是一款跨平台 AI 编码代理桌面应用，将 Claude Code 能力封装为免配置的一体化安装包。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，无需终端命令即可直接与 AI 助手协作编程。提供会话管理、模型配置、代码预览和自动更新等功能。
repos.summary_en: Pi Agent is a cross-platform AI coding agent desktop app that packages Claude Code capabilities into a standalone, zero-config application. Supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux, it enables seamless AI-assisted development without terminal commands. Features include session management, model configuration, code preview, and automatic updates.

repos.description: Agent-Native Terminal
repos.summary_zh: Termany 是一款 Agent-Native 终端，采用本地优先、云端就绪的架构。通过统一的 React 与 xterm.js 界面，支持 Web、桌面（Tauri）及未来云端部署。核心亮点在于无缝集成 Claude、Codex 等十余种主流 AI 编码代理，支持分屏多任务、文件树内嵌编辑与预览，并提供详细的 AI 使用成本与 Token 消耗分析面板。
repos.summary_en: Termany is an agent-native terminal with a local-first, cloud-ready architecture. It unifies Web, desktop (Tauri), and future cloud deployments under a single React and xterm.js UI. Key features include seamless integration of over a dozen AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, etc.), split-pane multitasking, inline file editing/preview, and a detailed dashboard for tracking AI usage costs and token consumption.

repos.description: Persistent, provider-neutral memory for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and MCP coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: PAXM 是一款专为 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code 等）设计的持久化、跨厂商记忆系统。它通过本地 SQLite 存储项目决策、架构规范与上下文，实现不同会话和不同代理间的知识无缝流转，解决每次新会话需重复解释项目背景的问题，且支持灵活切换 Zep、Mem0 等外部记忆存储提供商。
repos.summary_en: PAXM is a persistent, provider-neutral memory system designed for AI coding agents like Codex and Claude Code. It stores project decisions, conventions, and context locally via SQLite, enabling seamless knowledge transfer across different sessions and agents. It eliminates the need to re-explain project backgrounds and supports flexible switching between storage backends like Zep and Mem0.

repos.description: A bilingual teaching guide to Claude Code, organized as a readable   learning path covering architecture, execution flow, tool systems,   and the real writing process behind the guide.
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是一个双语教学指南，旨在从零开始系统学习 Claude Code 源码。通过结构化章节和实际执行流程分析，帮助开发者深入理解其架构设计、工具系统和核心模块。结合 VitePress 构建可导航网站，并提供完整的开发过程记录，适合 AI 编码代理架构研究与自学。
repos.summary_en: This bilingual teaching guide provides a structured learning path to study the Claude Code source code from scratch. It covers architecture, execution flow, tool systems, and real writing processes, enabling readers to build a clear mental model of its design and implementation. Built with VitePress for web navigation and includes full development transcripts.

repos.description: 让 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI Agent 成为你的跨平台电脑维修助手：64 个按需加载的 Playbook，覆盖诊断、清理、性能、网络与安全维护——C 盘爆满、电脑卡顿、流氓软件、应用迁移、数据恢复都能直接问；先取证、再计划，确认后修改。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个面向AI Agent的跨平台电脑维修Skill，提供64个按需加载的Playbook，覆盖Windows/macOS/Linux的诊断、清理、性能优化、网络与安全维护。采用
repos.summary_en: A cross-platform computer repair Skill for AI Agents, featuring 64 on-demand Playbooks covering Windows, macOS, and Linux diagnostics, cleanup, performance optimization, and security maintenance. Follows an evidence-first, plan-confirm-modify workflow for natural language-based PC troubleshooting.

repos.description: 一个用于重新生成 Cursor 设备 ID 和设置 Access Token 的 Cursor 扩展
repos.summary_zh: Fake Cursor 是一款专为 Cursor 编辑器设计的 VS Code 扩展，支持重新生成设备 ID、修补机器码获取逻辑及设置 Access Token，实现多账号共用同一设备。支持 0.45.x~0.46.x 版本，具备使用情况监控、自动备份配置等功能，适用于 Windows/macOS/Linux 系统。
repos.summary_en: Fake Cursor is a VS Code extension for Cursor editor that enables device ID regeneration, machine code patching, and Access Token configuration to allow multiple accounts on one device. Supports Cursor 0.45.x-0.46.x, featuring usage monitoring, config backup, and cross-platform support (Windows/macOS/Linux).

repos.description: Any Agent × Any Provider × Anywhere. Connect Cursor, Claude Code, OpenCode, or Codex to Slack, Telegram, Discord, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, WeChat — with any LLM provider.
repos.summary_zh: GolemBot 是一个革命性工具，允许将 Cursor、Claude Code、OpenCode 或 Codex 等任意 AI 编程代理与任何 LLM 提供商集成，并部署到即时通讯（IM）、HTTP 接口或自有产品中。它通过单一配置实现跨平台运行，无需修改代码或依赖特定 AI 框架，支持 13,000+ OpenClaw 社区技能，极大扩展了 AI 代理的应用场景。
repos.summary_en: GolemBot enables running any coding agent (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) with any LLM provider and deploying it to IM platforms, HTTP endpoints, or custom products. It requires zero code changes, supports 13,000+ OpenClaw community skills, and integrates seamlessly via configuration—no AI framework dependency.

repos.description: 使用Claude Code，Cursor, codex, gemini 写微信公众号文章工具。
repos.summary_zh: Article Writer 是一款专为微信公众号/自媒体设计的 AI 智能写作系统，集成 Claude、Cursor、Gemini 等 13 个 AI 助手平台。通过九步写作流程与四大多模式创作体系（教练/快速/混合/框架约束），结合素材库、文档爬虫与三遍审校机制，帮助用户产出高真实性、低 AI 检测率的内容，核心目标是保留人类真实表达与个性化细节。
repos.summary_en: Article Writer is an AI-powered intelligent writing system designed for WeChat Official Accounts and self-media content. Integrated with 13 AI assistants including Claude, Cursor, and Gemini, it features a 9-step writing workflow and four multi-mode creation systems (Coach/Quick/Hybrid/Outline-constrained). With material libraries, document crawlers, and triple-review mechanisms, it helps users produce highly authentic content with low AI detection rates, preserving human voice and personal details.

repos.description: Cloudflare Worker; Claude Code; Proxy; Easy to deploy; Claude Code Router; claude-code-router; ccr
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Worker 的 Claude Code 代理工具，支持将 Gemini 和 OpenAI 等第三方大模型 API 转换为 Claude 格式，实现零配置快速部署。核心特性包括流式响应、工具调用支持，并可通过 One-Balance 实现低成本 Claude Code 使用。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Cloudflare Worker-based proxy that converts third-party LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI) into Claude-compatible format, enabling zero-config deployment. It supports streaming/non-streaming responses, tool calls, and integrates with One-Balance for cost-effective Claude Code usage.

repos.description: Agent Skills for theming AI desktop apps: reference image → reversible Codex/WorkBuddy skin → verify, repair, publish. | 给 AI 桌面应用换肤的 Agent Skills：参考图 → 可逆皮肤 → 验证、修复、发布。
repos.summary_zh: CodeDrobe Skills 是一个开源的 AI 桌面应用主题生成与管理系统，专为 OpenAI Codex 和腾讯 WorkBuddy 等基于 Chromium/Electron 的 AI 桌面端提供可逆的主题定制方案。它通过 AI 技能（Skill）驱动，支持 DOM 快照分析、语义化主题生成与跨平台应用，极大简化了 AI 桌面环境的个性化与视觉管理。
repos.summary_en: CodeDrobe Skills is an open-source AI-driven theming engine for Chromium/Electron-based AI desktop apps like OpenAI Codex and Tencent WorkBuddy. It provides a reversible theme customization workflow utilizing DOM snapshot analysis and semantic generation. Managed via installable Agent Skills, it simplifies visual personalization and cross-platform theme deployment for AI desktop environments.

repos.description: 孙宇晨.skill — 注意力收割操作系统 | Justin Sun Perspective Skill for Claude Code | 由女娲.skill蒸馏
repos.summary_zh: 孙宇晨.skill 是基于1528行调研素材的深度蒸馏成果，提炼出6个核心心智模型与8条决策启发式，构建了一套以‘注意力收割’为核心的营销思维框架。该技能专为 Claude Code 设计，通过模拟孙宇晨的认知模式，提供高冲突性、强传播性的应对策略，适用于公关危机处理、热点事件响应及品牌叙事构建等场景。
repos.summary_en: Sun Yuchen.skill is a distilled framework of 6 core mental models and 8 decision heuristics, built from 1,528 lines of research material. It functions as an 'attention harvesting operating system' for marketing strategy, specifically designed for Claude Code to emulate Sun Yuchen's high-impact, controversial response patterns. It excels in crisis management, trend exploitation, and narrative construction through bold positioning and calculated provocation.

repos.description: Full-featured GUI for Claude Code CLI in VS Code — Windows (no WSL) & macOS. Third-party API, MCP plugins, Skills, Hooks, real-time token tracking. Actively maintained.
repos.summary_zh: 为 Windows 平台打造的 Claude Code 原生聊天界面扩展，提供现代化 UI 和自定义 API 支持，兼容 VS Code 和 Cursor，支持第三方 API 接入，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: A native Windows UI extension for Claude Code that enhances the CLI experience with a modern chat interface, custom API support, and seamless integration with VS Code/Cursor for improved developer productivity.

repos.description: 这是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 项目，它充当一个代理服务器，能够将 Claude API 格式的请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式。这使得任何与 Claude API 兼容的客户端（例如官方的 @anthropic-ai/claude-code CLI）都能够与任何支持 OpenAI API 格式的服务进行通信，如 Google Gemini, Groq, Ollama 等。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 代理服务器，可将 Claude API 请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式，支持动态路由至 Google Gemini、Groq、Ollama 等兼容服务，具备全功能 API 兼容、函数调用转换、Haiku 模型快捷配置及一键部署脚本，实现 Claude 客户端与多 AI 服务的无缝互通。
repos.summary_en: This is a TypeScript project deployed on Cloudflare Workers that acts as a proxy server, seamlessly converting Claude API requests to OpenAI API format. It enables any Claude-compatible client (e.g., @anthropic-ai/claude-code) to communicate with OpenAI-compatible services like Google Gemini, Groq, and Ollama via dynamic routing, full API compatibility, tool calling conversion, and one-click deployment.

repos.description: A cross-platform skills manager for AI IDEs. Search marketplace, download locally, and install to Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and more with one click.
repos.summary_zh: Skills Manager 是一款跨平台 AI IDE 技能管理工具，支持聚合搜索 Claude、Cursor、Windsurf 等10+主流AI开发环境的技能插件，一键下载至本地统一仓库并通过安全符号链接快速安装，提供版本控制、批量部署和自定义IDE支持，显著提升AI编程助手的功能扩展效率。
repos.summary_en: Skills Manager is a cross-platform AI IDE skills management tool that aggregates search across major marketplaces (Claude Plugins, SkillsLLM, etc.), downloads skills to a unified local repository, and enables one-click installation into 10+ supported AI IDEs via secure symlinks. It features version control, bulk deployment, and custom IDE support for enhanced AI programming assistant capabilities.

repos.description: 轻量级的clawdbot/openclaw，支持飞书，钉钉，QQ和企业微信
repos.summary_zh: OpenMozi 是一个轻量级、专注国产生态的 AI 助手框架，支持 DeepSeek、豆包、通义千问等国产大模型及 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容接口，提供统一的 Function Calling 能力。它原生集成 QQ、飞书、钉钉、企业微信等通讯平台适配器，内置 25 个工具（文件操作、浏览器自动化、定时任务等）、记忆系统、Skills 技能扩展机制，以及智能上下文压缩策略，适用于企业内部机器人和团队协作场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenMozi is a lightweight AI assistant framework focused on the Chinese ecosystem, supporting domestic LLMs like DeepSeek, Doubao, and Qwen via unified OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible interfaces with native Function Calling. It integrates adapters for QQ, Feishu, DingTalk, and WeCom, featuring 25 built-in tools (file ops, browser automation, cron jobs), memory system, Skills extension via SKILL.md, and intelligent context compression—ideal for enterprise bots and team collaboration.

repos.description: Git worktree-based task manager with integrated terminals for CLI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: Ouijit 是一款基于 Git worktree 的 AI 编程代理任务管理器，集成终端会话、生命周期钩子与脚本系统，支持 Claude Code、Codex 等代理工具。提供看板式任务管理、自动并行工作流、实时代理状态通知、VM 沙箱隔离及会话恢复等功能，无需账号、无遥测，专为 AI 辅助开发流程打造。
repos.summary_en: Ouijit is a Git worktree-based task and terminal session manager designed for AI coding agents. It integrates with Claude Code, Codex, and other agent CLIs via lifecycle hooks, scripts, and a session-aware CLI. Features include kanban task management, automatic parallel workstreams, live agent status with notifications, VM sandboxing for untrusted code, and session resumption—fully open-source with no accounts or telemetry.

repos.description: 轻量级的clawdbot/openclaw，支持飞书，钉钉，QQ和企业微信
repos.summary_zh: OpenMozi 是一个轻量级 AI 助手框架，专为国产生态设计，支持 DeepSeek、豆包、Qwen 等国产大模型及 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容接口，提供飞书、钉钉、QQ、企业微信等多平台机器人接入，具备 Function Calling、25 个内置工具、记忆系统、定时任务等核心功能，代码简洁（约1.6万行），适合学习 Agent 原理和快速开发企业级智能助手。
repos.summary_en: OpenMozi is a lightweight AI assistant framework designed for the Chinese ecosystem, supporting domestic LLMs like DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs. It offers multi-platform bot integration (Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, WeCom), native Function Calling, 25 built-in tools, memory system, cron jobs, and a skill-based architecture. With ~16K lines of clean code, it's ideal for learning agent principles and rapid development of enterprise-grade AI assistants.

repos.description: Local-first dashboard for observing Claude Code usage, cost, sessions, and time.
repos.summary_zh: Lumo是一款本地优先的桌面应用，专为开发者设计，用于追踪Claude Code的使用情况。它通过本地SQLite数据库收集并可视化成本、令牌消耗、会话时长和编码时间等关键指标，提供直观的仪表盘视图，无需云端账户或数据外传，完全在用户机器上运行。
repos.summary_en: Lumo is a local-first desktop application that tracks Claude Code usage by collecting telemetry data locally. It provides real-time dashboards for cost, tokens, sessions, and coding time using a native Tauri + Next.js UI, storing everything in a local SQLite database without requiring cloud accounts or external data transmission.

repos.description: 一套可直接安装到 ~/.codex 的专家配置，面向 Codex CLI / Codex App 桌面版的 Skill 调用方式 提供 3 个专家团、3 个单专家与 1 个总路由入口。
repos.summary_zh: 一套面向 Codex CLI / Codex App 桌面版的专家团配置方案，通过 Skill 调用方式将单一 AI 助手升级为可路由、可协作的多专家团队系统。提供软件开发、设计原型、产品战略三个专家团及一个总路由入口，覆盖 PRD、架构设计、编码、QA、原型构建、竞品分析、路线图等完整工作流。
repos.summary_en: A ready-to-install expert team configuration for Codex CLI / Codex App desktop, upgrading a single AI assistant into a routable, collaborative multi-expert team system via Skill invocation. Includes software engineering, design prototyping, and product strategy teams with a unified router, covering PRD, architecture, coding, QA, prototyping, competitive analysis, and roadmap workflows.

repos.description: 让 Claude Code 更易用，支持多配置切换。
repos.summary_zh: auo 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的 CLI 工具，通过多配置切换和环境变量管理提升使用体验。支持自动配置升级与向后兼容，适用于多账号/代理场景下的无缝切换，显著简化 Anthropic API 的复杂配置流程。
repos.summary_en: auo is a CLI tool designed to enhance Claude Code usability by enabling easy multi-configuration switching and environment variable management. It supports automatic config upgrades with full backward compatibility, ideal for seamless transitions between multiple accounts or proxy setups, streamlining Anthropic API configuration.

repos.description: A skill for coding agents that build, review, and refactor Web UI that should be easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate.
repos.summary_zh: 为AI编码代理提供的Web UI设计技能，指导构建、审查与重构前端界面，使其对人类、屏幕阅读器、浏览器自动化、Playwright测试及AI代理更友好。核心聚焦语义HTML、清晰状态、稳定定位器与可复现URL模式，附带分级审查报告，助力提升前端可访问性与自动化兼容性。
repos.summary_en: A skill for coding agents to build, review, and refactor Web UI that is easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate. It focuses on semantic HTML, clear state, stable locators, and reproducible URL patterns, providing severity-graded review reports to enhance accessibility and automation compatibility.

repos.description: Let AI truly understand you. A Claude Code skill that extracts tacit knowledge through structured dialogue. 隐性知识挖掘技能。
repos.summary_zh: tacit-mining 是一款基于 Claude Code 的隐性知识挖掘技能，融合 Polanyi 隐性知识理论与 CDM、Laddering 等认知科学方法，通过结构化对话从用户行为中反推其说不清的判断标准。支持写作、选题、产品、审美、受众五大领域，采用关键事件法、对比逼近等四种提取技术，将模糊直觉转化为带边界条件的精确规则，显著提升 AI 对用户深层偏好的理解深度。
repos.summary_en: Tacit-mining is a Claude Code skill that extracts users' tacit knowledge through structured dialogue, based on Michael Polanyi's theory and cognitive science methods like CDM and Laddering. It infers unspoken judgment criteria from behavioral patterns across five domains (writing, topics, products, aesthetics, audience), transforming vague intuitions into precise rules with boundaries via four extraction techniques, dramatically enhancing AI's understanding of deep user preferences.

repos.description: Claude Code Skill-driven resume system — one source, many tailored resumes
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Claude Code 的智能简历系统，支持从结构化经验数据自动生成多版本 LaTeX 简历。通过自然语言交互完成初始化、维护和定制化生成，实现同一份经历针对不同岗位的智能适配与重塑，输出专业 PDF 格式简历。
repos.summary_en: A skill-driven resume system powered by Claude Code that generates tailored LaTeX résumés from structured experience data. Features zero-config onboarding, AI-powered tailoring for multiple roles, natural language maintenance, and professional PDF output via XeLaTeX.

repos.description: A CLI/TUI tool to manage and switch tokens & base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex.
repos.summary_zh: agtok 是一个 CLI/TUI 工具，用于集中管理和切换 Claude、Gemini 和 Codex 等 AI 代理的令牌与基础 URL。支持交互式终端界面、预设分组、原子化写入与备份，适用于多环境 AI 工具配置管理。
repos.summary_en: agtok is a CLI/TUI tool for centrally managing and switching tokens and base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex. It supports interactive TUI, preset grouping, atomic writes with backups, and seamless configuration switching across environments.

repos.description: Local-first Codex orchestration for continuous product development
repos.summary_zh: Codrive 是一个本地优先的 Codex 编排工具，将产品想法转化为可视化的开发任务流。它连接 Codex App 对话、任务看板与文件系统，支持持续规划、独立审查、返工集成等全生命周期管理，无需额外基础设施，所有数据本地存储，为长期产品开发提供可靠工作流。
repos.summary_en: Codrive is a local-first Codex orchestration tool that transforms product ideas into visible task workflows. It connects Codex App conversations with a task board and filesystem state, supporting continuous planning, independent review, rework, and integration. Running entirely locally without external infrastructure, it provides a reliable workflow for long-running product development.
